description: This file is a shell script designed to run a series of Git tests related to repository setup, commit graph creation, and fetch behavior with promisor remotes.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit in the specified repository.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects success and runs the provided commands.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a given path points to an existing file.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the provided command fails.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in a file.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks the number of lines in the input.
